title: SCG-VTNet: skeleton-guided spatial visual feature fusion for static hand gesture recognition (v1.0.1)
description: Source code for SCG-VTNet, including model implementations, anatomy-aware landmark descriptors, feature extraction, baseline comparisons, matched and contiguous-block ASL evaluations, paired image degradation, zero-shot cross-dataset transfer, pair-grouped NUS evaluation, structured landmark-swap evaluation, screened original-image case rendering, multi-panel publication figure scripts, CPU timing, and verification scripts.
